level_stack.status: Historical 6.09 mm study, superseded by stock_display_connector and parameter_values_mm

plan.requested_outcome: Implement only approved R4 designs in native CAD, exports and public viewer, with approved whole-face height and display centering, preserving excluded artwork and camera/configuration continuity.
constraints: Consume approved paths and color roles literally; compare all top-face partitions against master, including full right reflection.
Translate full display module, contacts/plastics/solder reserves, mating PCB J2, glass cutout and clearance wells; inspect fixed supports and holes.
Preserve MCU, battery, caps, keys, mount datums and excluded artwork XY. Common frame geometry may change for the approved height and centered display.
Keep original default Flan and saved configurations; do not silently switch user frame choices. Mark deferred art as awaiting redesign.
Use isolated candidate, then save/reopen, validate nominal full assembly and all variants before adoption.
Native STEP/STL/material exports, scene and preview/downloads derive from same saved file; public site readback required.
Physical print and fit remain unqualified; PCB study is unrouted. Do not imply fabrication release.

source_registration.datum: Top of the two metal solder-contact faces on nominal PCB underside; body shoulder remains 0.15 mm below it.
source_registration.qualification: Nominal source registration only; no physical fit or solder-thickness qualification.

stock_display_connector.envelope_status: Supplier heights; nominal XY and contact reserves, not measured production tolerances

all_magnets.assembly: Pause and insert before closing both captive pockets. Keep magnets below the next nozzle path and secure against movement during resume. Qualify capture and actual thermal exposure with the existing coupon; use the temperature rating of the actual magnets. No adhesive-only retention.
all_magnets.acceptance: Digital clearance and vertical release only; measured north-edge peel, hold, sliding, insertion capture and cycling remain physical gates.
all_magnets.material: neodymium; grade and thermal rating must be checked against actual stock
all_magnets.polarity: All base mating faces use the same pole; every frame mating face uses the opposite pole. Verify each pair attracts in final assembled orientation before closing either pocket. Frames may print inverted: refer to the final mating face, not printer-up.
all_magnets.purchase: Use existing magnet kit: six diameter 2 x 3 mm and six diameter 2 x 4 mm magnets; no steel targets. Each extra pair of frames needs six more diameter 2 x 4 mm magnets.
all_magnets.legacy_ids: SteelTarget object names and frame-target PartIDs are stable historical identifiers; current visible labels and this specification define frame magnets.
